reason: My one big thing this month is something like a R3,000 skydive, and I'm not putting that through an app that launched last week when I can book straight with the operator I've already researched. The escrow sounds good on paper, but I don't know TradeSafe either, so I'll wait and see what the guys in the group say.
objection: Is my money actually safe with a brand-new app nobody I know has used? If the host flakes or the app disappears, who do I chase for my R3,000?
would_change_my_mind: A friend from my WhatsApp group booking through it first and getting a refund or entry with no problems, or the hosts I already trust listing it on their own pages as an official way to book.
